factor_specs.formula: expanding IC weights × (z_SUE + z_ESBR + z_EPS1M + z_TPGap), 0.6*HRP+0.4*Score tilt, bimonthly
factor_specs.lag_rule: Consensus roll=7d PIT join (C4 quarterly 45d), Score t-1 lag (C2)
factor_specs.neutralization: none (raw signal); HRP weighting at portfolio layer

factor_specs.proxy: 5-seed XGBoost ensemble, MI prefilter top 50 from 309 daily factors, RE features removed (S1_B variant)
factor_specs.formula: XGBoost(top50 features) ensemble mean; non-regime feature subset; CVaR LP weighting at portfolio layer

factor_specs.proxy: Q01_GPA + Q04_Piotroski_F + Q25_Ohlson_O (3-axis aggregate, Q07 EXCLUDED)
factor_specs.lag_rule: Q25 annual T+5M (May rebalance, C4); Q01/Q04 quarterly 45d
factor_specs.neutralization: none in Alpha; Optimizer applies sector cap

external_validation_framework.rationale: Iter1 단순 Carhart-4 도입은 KR HML 2016+ 시작 한계로 표본 확장 효과 미미 (n=40→46). 진짜 해결은 HML/RMW/CMA 모두 2002+로 backfill하여 풀 표본 n≈285 확보. Risk Agent에 DART TTM 기반 6-portfolio 구축 위임.
external_validation_framework.fallback_rationale: Risk Agent backfill 실패 시 (MKT/SMB/WML)로 후퇴, 풀 표본 n=91, t_NW=2.550 (게이트 미통과지만 robust)
external_validation_framework.parallel_specs_rationale: Multiple testing inflation 완화. 단일 cherry-pick spec 보고 금지 (RF-A6).
